## Summary

The May 1, 2026 guide describes creating and administering Terminal Locations and optional zones through its combined Dashboard and API variants. The November 7 capture is an index with Dashboard and API links. Operational details below come from the May capture.

## Locations and Zones (May 2026)

Register each reader to a Location before accepting payments. Multiple readers can share a Location. In the Dashboard, provide a name and a valid address so the reader uses the region’s configuration. A Location’s country is fixed after creation. For a different country, create a new Location and re-register the affected readers.

Dashboard zones are optional and can nest. A Location can belong to one zone at most. The May API variant supports creating and updating Locations and directs zone creation and modification to the Dashboard.

**Dashboard deletion prerequisites.** Remove associated readers before deleting their Location. To delete a zone, first clear the Locations under it. The guide allows moving Locations with readers to another zone. When deleting a Location as part of that cleanup, remove its readers first. See May raw lines 80–95.

## Required Address Fields (May 1, 2026)

The country groups and Beta labels below are from May raw lines 25–30. The November variant index supplies no updated country or Beta status.

| Required fields | Countries named by the guide |
| --- | --- |
| `line1`, `city`, `state`, `postal_code`, `country` | Australia, Canada, Italy, Japan (Beta), Spain, United States |
| `line1`, `city`, `postal_code`, `country` | Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia (Beta), Finland, France, Germany, Hungary (Beta), Latvia (Beta), Liechtenstein (Beta), Lithuania (Beta), Luxembourg, Malaysia, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Poland (Beta), Portugal, Romania (Beta), Slovakia (Beta), Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom |
| `line1`, `postal_code`, `country` | Bulgaria (Beta), Croatia (Beta), Cyprus (Beta), Ireland, Malta (Beta), Singapore, Slovenia (Beta) |
| `line1`, `country` | Gibraltar (Beta) |

## Connect and Connection Tokens (May 2026)

- **Direct charges.** Create the Location with `Stripe-Account`. Only the connected account authenticated in the request can access these Locations.
- **Destination charges.** The platform owns the Locations. A platform can store an optional connected-account reference in Location `metadata` when it needs the association.
- **ConnectionToken.** The optional server-side `location` parameter scopes the token to smart readers assigned to that Location. Omitting it applies no Location filter. The parameter has no effect on Bluetooth reader discovery. The reader registration requirement remains separate.

terminal-fleet-locations-and-zones.text: Group and manage your readers by physical location.
Before you can use a reader, you must register it to a location.
After you create a location, you can’t change its country.
You can’t create or modify zones using the API.
Only the Connect account you authenticate as can access these locations.
For Bluetooth readers, the `location` of a ConnectionToken has no effect.
Move the locations with readers to a different zone.
If your platform needs to associate accounts using destination charges with Locations, you can store a reference
If you don’t provide a Location, the ConnectionToken is usable with all readers.

terminal-fleet-locations-and-zones.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/locations-and-zones, the 2026-11-07 capture states the purpose of grouping/managing readers by physical location and offers Dashboard and API variants (new raw lines 5-14). It supplies no setup body or further prerequisites, actors or state transitions. In May, a Dashboard operator creating a Location supplies a name and a valid address with country-specific required fields. The address establishes the correct regional settings and configuration for readers operating there (old raw lines 23-32, old raw lines 46-54). The 2026-05-01 guide says the business must assign and register readers to Locations before taking payments, can group multiple readers per Location, and can optionally nest zones with at most one zone per Location. Dashboard operators create locations and zones, move locations and perform deletions after clearing relevant reader/location associations; an API integrator can create or update a Location but cannot create or modify zones. A Location country cannot change after creation, requiring a new Location and reader re-registration (old raw lines 8-36, old raw lines 40-105). Direct-charge Locations belong to the authenticated connected account accessed with Stripe-Account; destination-charge Locations belong to the platform and can optionally reference connected accounts using metadata. On the server, specifying the Terminal SDK ConnectionToken’s optional location filters to smart readers assigned to that Location; omitting the parameter applies no Location restriction. The parameter has no effect on Bluetooth readers, so nearby Bluetooth readers remain discoverable (old raw lines 124-126, old raw lines 150-152, old raw lines 176-180). The revised source-stripe-terminal-locations-and-zones.md preserves these historical topics, dates the country groups and restores the deletion prerequisites and optional metadata.
terminal-fleet-locations-and-zones.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/locations-and-zones, source-stripe-terminal-locations-and-zones.md adds a dated raw reference to Dashboard https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/locations-and-zones.md?dashboard-or-api=dashboard and API https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/locations-and-zones.md?dashboard-or-api=api (new raw lines 9-14). That presentation/navigation replaces the prior combined variants without establishing substantive changes to either body (old raw lines 38-44, old raw lines 97-105). Retain the 2026-05-01 dated tier rules and Beta flags from exact country lists, including Japan (Beta) in the state-required group, Gibraltar (Beta) in the line1/country group and both Switzerland and the United Kingdom in the line1/city/postal_code/country group (old raw lines 25-30). The November index leaves current Beta status unresolved. Preserve immutable Location country and re-registration, optional nested Dashboard zones, and prerequisite reader removal before Location deletion and clearing locations under a zone, with moving populated locations optional (old raw lines 32-36, old raw lines 56-101). Keep optional destination metadata and the direct-charge authenticated account boundary, as well as smart-reader token location scoping and the Bluetooth exception (old raw lines 124-126, old raw lines 150-152, old raw lines 174-180). The source links to the reciprocal stripe-terminal route and the separate reader-registration source. The proposed concept wording dates the country qualifications and describes the destination-charge metadata reference as optional.
